turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how have you been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not too bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My microwave is crusty inside. Like, years of soup explosions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Easy fix. Put a bowl of water with a sliced lemon in it, and run it for a few minutes until it steams up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, something else. Work chats are pinging me nonstop. I can't concentrate on anything.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two ways to handle it. A focus mode that hushes everything during set hours, or muting just the noisiest group chats. Which sounds better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, quick chat with Hannah. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hannah, taste this frosting. Too sweet?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm. It's sweet, but it's a birthday cake, so that's kind of the point.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was thinking of adding lemon juice.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ooh, lemon would be nice. Just a little.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you squeeze one for me? My hands are covered in sugar.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, where are the lemons?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: In the bowl by the window.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'll be back in a minute.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you get a reply about the job?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Still waiting, fingers crossed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All sorted, Moshi. Pick up where you were.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. About those nonstop work pings. Focus mode or muting a few chats?
